description: Reports whether Shodan's pre-collected passive scan data shows SNMP (UDP port 161) seen open on an IPv4 address. Passive and possibly old; no community string is tried, so default or public community access is not tested. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
